Package com.example.savings_app.controller

Class SavingsController

java.lang.Object
com.example.savings_app.controller.SavingsController
@RestController public class SavingsController extends Object
This is the controller class responsible for handling API requests related to Savings. It provides CRUD operations to interact with Savings data.
